en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 2.  Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s.) narrates from his ancestors that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, “Paradise awaits the arrival of those who love Ali (a.s.) in this world and it awaits to increase the light for the lovers of Ali (a.s.).
Similarly Hell awaits  the  enemies  of  Ali  in  this  world  with  horrible sounds.”
